title: T-33 (2026-11-13): every building buy is decided by the host BEFORE any money moves - BizManPresentation.SendBuyBuildingOffer is held by a prefix; a guest sends a BuyClaim and the host answers from one locked check-and-record against the deed ledger; the host's own buy runs the same check. A building whose deed another player holds is refused ('Another player already owns this building.'), money and ledger unchanged; a race for one unowned building yields exactly one owner; list/cancel/sale-done for a building need the DEED (a tenant is dropped); an unowned building still buys normally, charged once
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, client Client1; Murray Hill special rival ju1yVbREcE2B5ymg6q5tyA== owns for-rent buildings). Dev build with the realbuy + deedgate levers (TestDrive.cs, T-33) and rivalrent buy (client, no money). T3 races for the cheapest listed building and the race loser buys the second cheapest in T5 (realbuy unless lever), at the game's own minimum offer. Step 9 gives each player 20M (spend lever) for T1's minimum offer (a rival building's minimum can exceed 17M); step 18 takes 14M back so T3/T5's exact charge checks run under the float limit (16,777,216); step 35 refunds the guest for T2 (the lever answers ERR ... (premise - nothing pressed) otherwise). T2/T4 use the building the host bought. NOTHING is saved (fixture reset).

steps.note: the host's world loads
the client is served its save and settles

PREMISE: each player gets 20M through the game's own money path (spend lever; a negative amount earns), so every realbuy below clears the game's money check and minimum price and reaches the deed check
an empty building to give the guest (t-clientrealestate's way)
Client1 holds the deed (no claim: the DEV lever bypasses the buy screen; the host records it through BuyRequest)
PREMISE: the deed names Client1 on the host

steps.expect_result: ^OK realbuy addr='${addr1}' amount=\d+\.00 .* owned=False held=False deed=${clientPid}$

expect_log.regex: \[Buy\] buy of '${addr1}' by ${hostPid} @ \S+ REFUSED - the deed is held by ${clientPid}

steps.note: TEST: the host presses the game's real buy for the guest's building - refused in the prefix before any money moves (the game's own minimum offer: a lower offer stops at the game's price check before the deed check, T-33 fold F5)

steps.expect_result: ^OK realbuy last addr='${addr1}' .* owned=False once=False unchanged=True
steps.note: TEST: the host's money is unchanged
TEST: the ledger still names Client1
TEST: the guest still owns it

PREMISE: back under 16,777,216 - the game keeps money as a float, which above that can only hold even numbers, so T3/T5 once= (charged exactly the offer) needs a smaller balance; each player keeps ~9.5M, enough for one of the two cheapest buildings
leg order T1, T3, T5, T2, T4: each player can afford ONE building (step 18 money vs find's prices), so the race and the T5 buys come first and T2/T4 use the one building the host bought
the two cheapest listed buildings nobody holds: T3 races for the cheapest, the race loser buys the other in T5
both players press the game's buy for one unowned building, back to back (the lever answers ERR ... (premise - nothing pressed) if a player cannot afford it)

expect_log.regex: \[Buy\] buy of '${race}' by \S+ @ \d+ REFUSED - the deed is held by \S+

steps.note: exactly one of the two is refused (the oracle below checks there is exactly one owner)
TEST: the host owns it exactly when the deed names the host
TEST: the guest owns it exactly when the host does not - one owner, never two, never none

steps.expect_result: ^OK realbuy last addr='${race}' .* (owned=True once=True|owned=False once=False unchanged=True)
steps.note: TEST: the host was charged once if it won, nothing if it lost

steps.note: TEST: the guest was charged once if it won, nothing if it lost

steps.note: T5 host leg: if the host lost the race it buys the spare building normally on the host; if it won, its race buy (step 25 once=True) is its charged-once leg and nothing is pressed
T5 guest leg: if the guest lost the race its claim for the spare building is sent (granted below); if it won, its race buy is its leg
the guest's claim answer, BuyRequest and market removal settle

steps.note: TEST (T5 host side): the host owns the one unowned building it bought normally and was charged exactly the offer, once

steps.note: TEST (T5 guest side): the guest owns the one unowned building it bought and was charged exactly the offer, once, with no claim left waiting
TEST: the race loser holds the spare building's deed on the host (a guest's BuyRequest confirmed it)
TEST: the guest owns the spare building exactly when the host won the race

PREMISE: the host holds the deed of the building it bought in T3/T5
